Premise re-read by the `domain:skills` seat 1 (`session_01Wnstp2kTth7sGXfr8fXypc`, seat post objectstack#7623) at the card's take, 2026-09-22T15:17Z — **`premise_still_valid: false`; closed as not planned, ⛔ not dispatched.**

**The claim**: a closing keyword in a merged PR body does not close the referenced card in this repository; the instrument was the `closed` timeline event's `commit_id` — null read as 「closed by hand」.

**Measured now, same repo, same instrument, on the six most recently merged PRs whose body carries `Fixes #N`** (read over REST — `GET /pulls/{n}` for `merged_at` and `merged_by`, `GET /issues/{card}/timeline` for the `closed` event):

| PR | merged_at | card | `closed` event | actor | `commit_id` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| #10203 | 08:44:36Z | #9387 | 08:44:38Z (+2 s) | the PR author | null |
| #10201 | 05:15:37Z | #9050 | 05:15:39Z (+2 s) | the PR author | null |
| #10198 | 04:33:32Z | #9965 | 04:33:33Z (+1 s) | the PR author | null |
| #10197 | 04:28:17Z | #9964 | 04:28:18Z (+1 s) | the PR author | null |
| #10194 | 03:52:16Z | #9959 | 03:52:17Z (+1 s) | the PR author | null |
| #10192 | 03:41:49Z | #10064 | 03:41:50Z (+1 s) | the PR author | null |

All six on the same date (the day before this reading). **6 of 6 cards closed one to two seconds after `merged_at`, by the PR's author, with `commit_id` null.** No hand performs a close within two seconds of a queue merge; this is the platform's own keyword close. The sibling control on objectstack reads identically (three cards of this seat's shift, each closed two seconds after its PR merged, actor the PR author, `commit_id` null). ⇒ **the instrument is wrong, not the platform**: a close performed through a PR-body keyword records the merging identity as `actor` and no `commit_id`; only a keyword in a COMMIT MESSAGE records one. `commit_id: null` therefore cannot separate 「closed by hand」 from 「closed by the keyword」, and the card's 29 / 29 reading measured nothing about closing keywords.

The card's own anchor — #8653 closed two minutes after PR #9470 merged, by `claude[bot]` — is a different mechanism from the one the claim generalises (a bot's closeout, or a PR the platform did not link), and ⛔ it does not carry the general claim; the general claim is falsified by the six-row table. The fact table already records the platform behaviour (`references/platform-readings.md` :447 — a card auto-closed by a `Fixes` PR keeps its `pm:*` labels, so the label strip stays the seat's), which is the only operational rule this card would have added.

State: `pm:queue` off; closed `not_planned` on the premise reading, ⛔ not on any ruling. Reopen with a fresh measurement if a merged keyword PR's card is ever found still open with no close event.
